procedural_matters: The Race Committee was represented by Jan Prockat
Peder Rost, member of the Race Committee, attended the hearing as a witness for the Race Committee.
facts: The Protest was lodged at 1630 hrs.
The Race committee vessels returned ashore at 1600 hrs. and lodged the protest 30 minutes later.
There was no notice on the notice board, nor was the sailor informed in any way, before the hearing schedule was posted.
conclusions: The Race Committee failed todeliver the protest within the protest time limit as required by RRS 60.3.
The Race Committee failed toinform the protestee of his intention to protest as required by RRS 60.2(a)(2).
There was no good reason toextend the time limit.
